info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 2
info.description:
Employee management REST API (Node.js, Express, MongoDB) used by the React frontend.

Run the folders in order: Health -> Signup -> Login -> Employees (User A) -> Cross-user ownership -> Search -> Profile pictures -> CORS -> Rate limiting (run last).
{{baseUrl}} is http://localhost:5000 (both for "npm run dev" and for Docker Compose).

Picture uploads use the files in postman/fixtures. Newman finds them with --working-dir postman.
In the Postman app, if a file shows as missing, re-select it in the request's Body -> form-data tab
(or set Settings -> General -> Working directory to the postman folder).

Rate limits: signup and login allow AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX requests per 15 minutes per IP (default 5),
and all /api routes allow API_RATE_LIMIT_MAX (default 100). A full run sends more than that, so start
the backend with higher limits for testing, e.g. AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=20 API_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=300.
The counters are kept in memory: restart the backend before running the collection again.
The 429 test is in the last folder, so it never blocks the other requests.
